charts.title: TOI-1799 b: orbits around TOI-1799
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1799's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1799 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Polanski et al. 2024 (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname POLANSKI_ET_AL__2024): P 7.085738 d

charts.title: TOI-1799 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1799 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (22, 48) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 8967242, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 12 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 36 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 12 min early; 10-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 12 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
